about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

39d1a70.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by GitHub Pages sha256-match origin/main at 39d1a70, twelve for twelve, before the shutter.

153ea1b.note: main 153ea1b - #645 landed the magnified ceiling share (CGWN=1); CGW still 0

28a6fa4.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire first: for each of the four, the sha256 of the bytes served by https://lioreshai.github.io/breach-protocol-flash-next/ equals git show <build>:<file>, 4 for 4 - so the browser drew the build this tree ships, which is what makes these frames a property of the build and not of a harness (#388, #597).

1f91555.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by GitHub Pages sha256-match origin/main at 1f91555, twelve for twelve, before the shutter. This is the build the #616 far-surface work (#739, #754) and the stand-under storey generator (#421, #631) ship together.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the DEPLOYED page for #616 (with #766) at build 1f91555. The pass proved that page byte for byte before the shutter: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by that URL sha256-match origin/main at 1f91555, twelve for twelve. One page load and one boot per pose, ?dev=1&seed=60&boot=0, viewport pinned to 1440x763, shutter taken from the canvas after DEV.tick; every seat, layout and luma below was read back out of the page that drew the frame, never carried from the row it replaces. The three dealt signatures moved between the replaced frames and these - the generator authors height and prop placement in its dice now (#421, #631, #757) - so a caption here claims the picture these bytes draw and the route that redraws them, and no longer the geometry of one deal.
